author: Claude
note: Positioning is quietly constructive rather than loudly bullish. ASX is the strongest board: 62% of qualifying setups lean long and the bot's ASX slice is the only green book (+0.66R across 10 positions), led by FWD (+0.80R) and CCP (+0.34R) — weekly-level reclaims are doing the work. NASDAQ is two-sided: breadth leans long (141 vs 112) but the bot's 10 positions net out flat (−0.08R), with KHC (+0.64R) offset by TSLA (−0.63R) — treat single-name momentum there with more respect than index direction. Crypto is thin and mixed (5 long / 4 short setups, bot −0.14R on 4) — no edge worth pressing. Overall: favour ASX longs at weekly 200-SMA reclaims, be selective on NASDAQ, leave crypto alone until breadth picks a side.
basis: Derived from today's published scans (breadth of qualifying setups by direction) and the paper bot book's open-position R. Commentary only — the bot trades its rules, never this note.
